intro:
Biohacking is a broad concept, from technologies for creating the posthuman of the future to using the knowledge of biology to improve the quality of life. In projection to dermatology, biohacking can be all preventive and lifestyle principles that will help to keep the skin healthy and beautiful for as long as possible. Biohacking skincare involves using products that will not overload it.

Biohacking skin should definitely include cleansing, toning, and cream application. But sometimes, the basic steps are not enough to improve the condition of the skin. Products that help in biohacking skincare are peculiar in that they effectively fight problems while not overloading the skin. Thus, the maximum result from their use is achieved.
highlights: Active ingredients like enzymes and peptides fuel visible skin results.
Bacterial lysates top the list of anti-aging biohacking components.
ALLTOME Cream fights aging with lysates, prebiotics, and niacinamide.
Infrared light boosts ATP, fights stress, and regenerates skin cells.
Brands like LYMA and SickScience lead biohacking skincare trends.

blocks.text: Ingredients to Look For in Biohacking Skincare

What distinguishes biohacking beauty cosmetics from others? Such cosmetic products contain physiological components – active substances that are easily assimilated and [work perfectly](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2921764/) as they relate to our bodies. These are amino acids, vitamins, minerals, enzymes, nucleic acids, lipids, and lactic acids (resources). They are usually taken from natural objects such as bacterial lysates, mushroom extracts (shiitake, cordyceps, etc.), mucin, kombucha, and other fermented foods. Also, a must-have feature of biohacking skincosmetics is the therapeutic concentration of active ingredients sufficient to produce the desired visible effect.

Recent scientific studies highlight bacterial lysates as a potent ingredient. They are rich in amino acids, vitamins, minerals, nucleic acids, and lipids, making them one of the most effective tools for slowing skin aging, improving resilience, and reducing inflammation.

[Retinol](https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamadermatology/fullarticle/412795#google_vignette) is also one of the most studied and effective ingredients in biohacking beauty. It stimulates collagen production, accelerates cell turnover, and visibly reduces fine lines and pigmentation. In therapeutic concentrations, it helps reprogram skin aging at the cellular level, making it a cornerstone of advanced, result-oriented skincare.
Additionally, many biohacking skincare products are free from synthetic fillers, parabens, and unnecessary preservatives, focusing instead on targeted efficacy and skin compatibility.
Here are some popular and resultative products our experts have found.
Best Biohacking Skincare Products
Cleansing
Good cleansing is the key to healthy skin! What is the best way to wash your face? The answer to this question depends on your skin type and how often you use makeup. The basic rules are as follows:

items: Choose dense, nourishing products for drier skin, such as hydrophilic oil, balm (for example,POREBARRIER CLEANSING BALM), or milk. For oilier skin types, products with a light texture that won’t weigh down the skin are more suitable, such as lotion or gel. You can use universal products for normal skin types, such as micellar water(Needly MILD MICELLAR CLEANSING WATER, etc).

Women should choose special two-phase products to remove long-lasting makeup. Only they can cope with waterproof formulas resistant to conventional cleansing products. At the same time, light everyday makeup can be removed with any makeup remover you like.

blocks.text: Toning

Several high-performance products stand out for skin toning within a biohacking routine due to their ability to work at the cellular level. Peptide-infused serums are among the most effective, as they stimulate collagen and elastin synthesis, visibly firming the skin over time. One well-known option isThe Ordinary “Buffet” + Copper Peptides 1%, which combines multiple peptide complexes with copper for enhanced skin resilience and tone.

Mushroom-based formulas also play a vital role in toning; rich in adaptogens and antioxidants, they help strengthen the skin barrier and even our complexion.Youth To The People’s Adaptogen Soothe + Hydrate Activated Mistis a great example, featuring reishi and ashwagandha to hydrate and tone. Retinol-based creams or plant-based alternatives like bakuchiol support tone and texture by accelerating cell turnover and improving skin structure.
Serum

Serums are a treasure trove of beneficial substances with enormous potential to help your skin! The high percentage of active ingredients and their high concentration make this product indispensable in your makeup bag. What makes this product so special? Thanks to its lighter texture, the serum can penetrate the skin better, allowing the ingredients to more effectively affect the deeper layers of the epidermis and, compared to cream, work better and target the problem area. This way, you can eliminate breakouts, remove acne scars, or work on firming the skin and getting rid of fine lines.

Serums can have instant or prolonged effects. The cumulative effect will be noticeable if you use the product regularly for more than a month. Such serums usually contain ingredients such as peptides, which need time to work. When it comes to instant effects, such products usually moisturize and contain hyaluronic acid, which quickly nourishes the skin, or сentella, which soothes and helps fight irritation and redness.

For example, youth Body Serum from Is Clinical is a rejuvenating body serum that contains patented Extremozymes® technology. It is lightweight and quickly absorbed. Extracts of watermelon, blue microalgae, Eriodictyon California, licorice root, hyaluronic acid, and vitamin B5 help to deeply moisturize, nourish, and protect the skin from the negative effects of the environment. Effective after sun exposure, softening the skin and making it more elastic and firm. Fights the first signs of aging by improving cell metabolism. Extremozymes® help protect the skin from damage caused by environmental aggressors.

Dermalogica Pro Collagen Banking Serum is a great tool to biohack your skin too! It contains collagen amino acids to help support collagen production and carnosine dipeptide, a biomimetic peptide that improves skin resilience. This serum visibly plumps skin and supports collagen production.
Creams
Day cream

In addition to its main functions, anti-aging day cream for the face can also provide protection from ultraviolet rays. Pay attention to the SPF (sun protection factor) label and other identifying marks. Anti-aging products often indicate the age group for which they are intended on the packaging.ALLTOME anti-aging face cream BIOHACKING SOLUTIONS with bacterial lysates, prebiotics, and niacinamide has a powerful anti-inflammatory activity, stimulates skin immunity, actively fights photo-aging, and helps to reduce age spots.
Night cream

During sleep, our strength is restored, as is our body and skin. During this time, the resources expended during the day are replenished, so a good anti-aging night cream contains ingredients that reveal their potential during recovery. Antioxidants, collagen, vitamins, and peptides are just a few of the ingredients that may be present in a night cream for mature skin. Beautystat Peptide Wrinkle Relaxing Moisturizer contains two different neuropeptides and moisturizes greatly.Peptidesact as signaling molecules that can produce collagen and repair damage.
Studies have shown that a new kind, neuropeptides, can tell your face muscles to relax, which smooths wrinkles almost as well as Botox.
Eye cream

Do you need to buy a separate product for the eye area? The answer is yes! The skin in this area is thinner and more sensitive and requires special care. In addition, such products help solve local problems: they fight dark circles, work on expression lines, and reduce bags under the eyes.Best eye cream overall:Medik8 Crystal Retinal Ceramide Eye!
Mask

A face mask offers a more thorough cleanse than everyday face washes. It penetrates deep into the pores to remove dirt, oil, dead skin cells, and toxins that accumulate from pollution or makeup. This helps prevent blackheads, breakouts, and dullness, leaving your skin feeling refreshed and purified.

Couperosis mask, Dr. Belter® Cosmetic, is a moisturizing and protective cream mask with a scientifically proven formula based on a soothing[herbal complex](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/botanical-biohacking); it is specially created for skin with redness and couperosis. Red grape extract and resveratrol have antioxidant effects, increase the skin’s natural defense mechanism, and give radiance and healthy color. Horse chestnut, troxerutin, and needle thorn increase elasticity and strengthen capillaries. Hyaluronic acid moisturizes and prevents skin fragility. Indian frankincense extract and glycyrrhizic acid soothe and relieve redness and inflammation and have an antimicrobial effect. Microspheres with vitamin A promote skin cell renewal. Olive, karate, and jojoba oils gently nourish and moisturize the skin. The mask is applied once a week for 15 minutes on pre-cleaned skin, after which it should be washed off with water.
Please note that although these products are backed by scientific evidence, the information provided is for guidance only! Remember that certain ingredients may cause an individual reaction.
Other Functional Skincare Enhancers

In addition to traditional actives, biohacking skincare embraces a range of non-standard functional enhancers, innovative ingredients, and technologies that go beyond conventional beauty routines. These include topical NAD+ precursors (like nicotinamide riboside) that support cellular energy metabolism and promote youthful skin function. Another unique category is exosome-based products, which harness cell-to-cell communication molecules to accelerate regeneration and visibly improve tone and texture. Some advanced formulas use neuro cosmetic peptides, which help relax facial tension and reduce expression lines without injections.

Infrared Light Therapy

[Infrared light therapy](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/red-light-therapy-biohacking-methods-for-health-benefits) is a physiotherapeutic procedure based on exposure to a powerful stream of natural red and infrared light from 650 to 850 nm. The technology behind infrared therapy lies in the natural ability of the skin and cell mitochondria to absorb light waves and convert them into ATP energy. ATP-acid or Adenosine Triphosphate is the main energy source for the normal functioning of cells, organs, and body systems. What are the benefits?

Stops inflammatory processes.

The procedure has no contraindications and is absolutely comfortable even for home use.
Facial Massages

[Facial massage](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/face-massage) is an art and science that aims to improve blood circulation, strengthen facial muscles, and promote skin health. This type of massage has become popular not only because of its relaxing effect but also because of its many benefits.
Facial massage is a biohacking skincare tool for strengthening the skin, renewing its appearance, stimulating blood circulation, and alleviating tension in the facial muscles.

This procedure, performed systematically, provides noticeable results, avoiding dramatic methods such as surgery. This method can be used not only as an anti-aging treatment but also to reduce the appearance of wrinkles and combat the loss of skin elasticity.
Here are some of the benefits of facial massage to biohack your skin:

items: Slows down the formation of wrinkles and makes them less visible;
Restores skin elasticity, leaving the skin looking fresh;
Helps fight swelling and double chins;
Promotes an even complexion by stimulating blood flow;
Stimulates skin regeneration processes.

blocks.text: Some points on our face affect the functioning of internal organs. Stimulation of these organs through massage can help improve the general condition of the body.
Cold Therapy

[Cryotherapy](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-cryotherapy), or cold therapy, is applying extremely low temperatures to the skin for therapeutic purposes. This exposure increases blood circulation, stimulates collagen production, and maintains skin health. In addition, cold can be used to reduce inflammation and improve metabolic processes at the cellular level.

One of the main benefits of cryotherapy is the stimulation of blood circulation, which leads to the activation of metabolic processes in the skin cells. This helps deliver nutrients and oxygen to the cells, speeding up their regeneration.
Cold therapy promotes the production of collagen, the main protein responsible for the elasticity and youthfulness of the skin.
Regular use of the treatments will help to make wrinkles less visible and improve skin tone. Cold also helps to shrink pores and reduce the severity of redness.
Step-by-step guide to home cryotherapy:

items: Cleanse your face to remove makeup and impurities.
To avoid direct skin damage, wrap ice cubes (or use a cryo roller or cold spoon) in a soft cloth.
Gently massage the face in upward, circular motions for 1–2 minutes, focusing on puffiness-prone areas like under the eyes or along the jawline.
Apply a soothing serum or moisturizer immediately to lock in hydration and support recovery.
Repeat 3–5 times a week for optimal results and skin rejuvenation.

blocks.text: How to Create a Personalized Biohacking Skincare Routine
Morning routine

[Your morning routine](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/morning-routine-biohacks) should focus on protection and activation. Start with a gentle cleanser, followed by a hydrating toner or essence with prebiotics or adaptogens. Apply an antioxidant or peptide serum like [vitamin C](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28805671/) or copper peptides to energize and tone the skin. Finish with a lightweight moisturizer and a broad-spectrum [SPF](https://www.aad.org/media/stats-sunscreen), preferably enhanced with DNA-repair enzymes or melatonin for added cellular defense.
Evening routine

Evening is the time for deep repair and renewal. Begin with a double cleanse to remove impurities. Use a treatment serum with active ingredients like retinol, bakuchiol, or topical NAD+ to support regeneration. Follow with a nourishing night cream rich in lipids, amino acids, or fermented extracts. For advanced care, add exosome serums, growth factors, or ozonated oils to stimulate overnight skin recovery.
To sum up

Biohacking skincareis a modern way of transforming beauty, exploring new techniques, treatments, and trends to enhance longevity and cellular function. There are plenty of tools, cosmetics, gadgets, and instruments to do it as effectively as possible. Just choose the most convenient way for you and your skin type, and don’t forget that everything must be firmly under the doctor’s control! Don’t be afraid of biohacking innovations; they will help you**biohack your skin** without any side effects!

Important to notice! This article does not constitute medical advice! Please bear in mind that active ingredients such as retinol, peptides and vitamin C, as well as light therapy, may cause individual reactions. Be sure to consult a specialist before incorporating them into your beauty routine. Also, carry out a patch test: apply a small amount of the product to the back of your hand or wrist and monitor your skin’s reaction over the course of a day.
